name: Fizzle Brassbolts
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Fizzle Brassbolts works on the salt flats of Thousand Needles. He and Pozzik founded the raceway to pit gnomish precision against goblin ingenuity in rocket car races. Fizzle seeks parts, fuel, and desert reagents for his team.

sections.title: A Matter of Principle and Pistons
sections.body: Fizzle Brassbolts came to the Shimmering Flats to prove gnomish craftsmanship superior to goblin tinkering. With the goblin engineer Pozzik, he laid out the Mirage Raceway. Race cars, pit crews, and spectators soon filled the basin.

sections.title: Tinkering on the Flats
sections.body: The dry salt beds keep Fizzle improvising. He tests mixtures made with local creature venom and contracts travelers to find replacement mechanical parts. His aim is to keep his driver's wheels turning faster than any goblin contraption.

faq.answer: Fizzle Brassbolts leads the gnomish racing crew at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. He is a master gnomish engineer.

faq.q: Why did Fizzle come to the Shimmering Flats?
faq.answer: Fizzle came to the Shimmering Flats to settle a technical debate with the goblin engineer Pozzik over whose racecars have superior engineering. Together they established the Mirage Raceway, where their rocket cars compete head-to-head on the flat salt basin.

Fizzle and his brother Wizzle Brassbolts run the gnomish racing team at the Mirage Raceway. Their new rocket car is so fast that its pilots keep crashing, so they asked their friend Pilot Longbeard in Ironforge for siege engine crash helmets.

faq.q: Why does Fizzle need creature venom for race cars?
faq.answer: Fizzle tests local reagents to make engine fluids, additives, and accelerants that might give his rocket cars an edge over Pozzik's machines.

faq.q: Does Fizzle fight against the goblins?
faq.answer: Fizzle does not fight the goblins with weapons. He and Pozzik maintain an uneasy, neutral truce at the raceway so they can focus on high-speed competition.
Pilot Longbeard is a dwarven siege engine pilot with the Ironforge Siege Brigade. He is a friend of the Brassbolts brothers and shares their fondness for dangerous machinery.

angles.text: As a gnome, you carry Gnomeregan's honor into the desert, seeking to prove gnomish precision outperforms goblin recklessness.
As an engineer, you can appreciate Fizzle's efforts to improve rocket propulsion and draw up advanced automotive designs in harsh desert conditions.
As an Alliance wanderer, you can find a friendly face and mechanical work with Fizzle in the neutral speed zone as you travel south toward Tanaris.
